description: List tags (lightweight: the manual tasks_order arrays are omitted — use get_tag for a tag's full ordering). Tags organize contacts, entries, tasks, notes, and companies. Use q to find a tag by name. Archived tags (closed projects) are included unless you pass archived=false; each tag's archived_at tells which.

archived.description: true: only archived tags; false: only active tags (default: both)

favorite.description: true: only the user's favorite tags (sidebar); false: only non-favorites (default: both)

name: list_tags
